description: This file defines the interface for Telemetry in the WPEFramework, including methods for reporting, uploading, and managing telemetry data, as well as notifications for report upload status.

classes.name: ITelemetry
classes.description: Interface for Telemetry operations including report management, notifications, and telemetry settings.

classes.name: ITelemetry::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for telemetry report upload events.

classes.name: ITelemetry::TelemetrySuccess
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of telemetry operations.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for telemetry events.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Set the status of telemetry reporting.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Log an application event with name and value.
